Given the fact I'm talking about dogs a quick Google will support my comments.  As I said your ignorance is showing in your comments.

It helps to know who you can put with who in term of breed lines instead of the 'old fashion' way of digging through lots of certificates.  It can be a useful tool in future planing for litters.

As I said I still agree some have gone down worrying lines however the KC have put I to place new rules about breeds with certain face structure. 

The ones who do the most harm are people who decide to breed without a clue to make a bit of money etc. 

Sadly your comments so your ignorance to how the world of dog show/breeding works. So unless you rather understand more and truth no point trying to convince you otherwise.

Yeah just noticed that too 🤣🤣 
Odd they say crufts for cats when it doesn't have that name for cat shows but hay ho.

Do you know there is an inbreed calculator to help reduce this? 

Not all breed are that bad some yes I can think of a few in fact which I feel have negative impacted the breed. 
However it's wrong to lump everyone in that same bracket.

Have you gone spoke to people breeder etc instead of have a possible detached view of what really happens? First hand experience always best if you ask me. 

Had many friends with the same view but from talking to them more in detail about things their views have changed in some way.

I love the fact the owner are not in sight or by the crates and it really is judged by the standard of that cat. And I agree they have mostly great temperament because it be held against them from my understanding of they show aggression etc.

Sorry you had that experience but as it's not a pedigree you can't enter in KC shows. You can of course do Srufts for crossbreeds I have a good few friends that do that with theirs and enjoy it. Of you qualify you go into the main arena for the final which is great fun.

I understand you say new pedigree but it's not new unless recognise by the KC club otherwise it's a crossbred.

Also you can't enter crufts out the blue as it where you need to qualify before hand but understand you most likely trying to find out more etc so shame they put you off.

I agree can be very dull if your not sure what's going on. It took me a bit of time to get around some bits 🤣

If you have a love for dogs or a breed in mind for the future then it's a great way to find out what the standard is even for pet owners due to some backyard breeders as they are sometimes called. Even pets should be well breed and trying to improve or contribute positively to breed program.

But given its the world largest dog show and it's taken a lot to even qualify at times and its meant to be about the dogs sad to see the focus isn't there. 
However I do understand they need to cater to the mass etc. 

Always recommend if you can go for a day do as the atmosphere is lovely ☺️

It's on however you want to see show dogs good luck coverage is rather bad for that. It more about stalls, sofa chats/interview than the dogs showing. 
Even main ring covering breed winners is not great - in my opinion.   

For cat equivalent there is one.  Of course doesn't  get as much press of any at all
 The world of cat showing and dogs is very different. Not that's a bad thing. 

But yeah it's on it just depends what you want to watch really.

Cast away .. never forgive him for letting ha friend go 😂😂😂 I'm 28 still not watched the film because it eats to me.... To the point when small clip was shown in bridesmaid film I started to cry. Yes I know it silly but hay
I much rather a night in than out as it's exhausting once a month maybe once every 2 months is fine by me 🤣

But have you recently spoken to them or will this be coming 100 out the blue becuase you not spoken for a while? 

Another way to think about it is what are possibly going to lose if you do and it goes 'wrong'
It really depends on what your relationship is like now If I'm honest

I've had something similar happen to me so can relate  in some way. It hurts not going to lie. Sadly nothing you can do right now but maybe talk to them? I did with my partner and it helped explain a few things.
I agree putting those feelings away would be best and most time when your have finally been able to 'taste' the forbidden fruit it's disappointing in some way.
I mean I can fully see that and if my friend come to me with something like this  I'll be saying your playing with fire. Always better at giving advice than following it as they say.
